entries.quote: Customers with communicating smart meters are on a standardized billing cycle. Your bill will cover a consistent number of days each month—30 days in the winter (October – April) and 31 days in the summer (May – September).
entries.location: NB Power 'Reading a Typical Bill' (read 2026-10-30); block 'for first 5000 kWh per Billing Period' in Rate Schedules and Policies effective April 14, 2026: N-2 General Service Rate Schedule, General Service I (https://www.nbpower.com/en/accounts-billing/understanding-your-bill/rate-schedules-and-policies/n-rate-schedules-and-rate-application-guidelines/; printable version https://www.nbpower.com/media/1494118/2026-27-rate-schedules-and-policies-effective-2026-04-14.pdf, PDF page 51)
entries.note: User decision 2026-10-30: per Billing Period = per month because NB Power's billing terms confirm monthly billing. Same page: 'For customers with non-communicating or legacy meters ... The typical range is 28 to 33 days in a billing period'; https://www.nbpower.com/en/accounts-billing/understanding-your-bill/standardized-billing/ (read 2026-10-30): 'Winter months (October to April), billing periods will be 30 days' / 'Summer months (May to September), billing periods will be 31 days' for homes and businesses with communicating smart meters. The approved rate book defines 'Billing Period' only as 'The period of time for which a Customer is billed for services provided by NB Power.' (B Definition of Terms, PDF page 7). Was null from 2026-10-16 to 2026-10-30.

entries.quote: The structure of monthly Rate G for an annual contract is as follows:
entries.location: Electricity Rates 2026: article 3.2 (block '12.388¢ per kilowatthour for the first 15,090 kilowatthours'), PDF page 37 (printed page 33); article 12.11, PDF page 154
entries.note: Article 12.11: 'The monthly rates described in these Rates are applied without adjustment when the consumption period is 30 consecutive days'; for other durations 'the number of kilowatthours or hours of use included, if applicable, in each rate tier' is divided by 30 days and multiplied by the days in the consumption period (a 30-day month).

entries.quote: The structure of monthly Rate M for an annual contract is as follows:
entries.location: Electricity Rates 2026: article 4.2 (block '6.292¢ per kilowatthour for the first 210,000 kilowatthours'), PDF page 47; article 12.11, PDF page 154
entries.note: Article 12.11: monthly rates apply unadjusted to a 30-day consumption period; the kWh in each rate tier is prorated per day for other durations (a 30-day month).
